origin: Brad Jones Racing (BJR) began not with grand ambitions, but from a genuine love of motorsport nurtured in rural Australia. Brad Jones, a talented driver himself, started out tinkering with cars in his father's workshop in Albury, New South Wales. Early days were spent competing in local touring car series, fueled by passion and a shoestring budget. A pivotal moment came when they secured a minor sponsorship from a regional transport company, allowing them to upgrade their aging Holden Commodore and compete more seriously. The team remained a family affair for many years, with Kim Jones, Brad's brother, heavily involved in the engineering side.
philosophy: BJR's philosophy has always been about maximizing resources and cultivating a strong team spirit. They believe in a pragmatic approach to car development, focusing on reliability and consistency rather than chasing outright speed at all costs. The team culture is one of hard work, loyalty, and a 'never give up' attitude, reflecting their humble beginnings and the challenges they've overcome.
achievements: Multiple podium finishes in the Australian Touring Car Championship (ATCC)
Consistent top-ten finishes in major endurance races like the Bathurst 1000
Developing and nurturing young driver talent who have gone on to bigger opportunities
Securing a factory-backed engine deal, a significant step forward for the team

teamPrincipal.name: Brad Jones
teamPrincipal.background: Brad Jones, the founder and heart of the team, is a former driver with a deep understanding of racing. He leads with a hands-on approach, valuing practical experience and fostering a close-knit environment.

keyFigures.name: Kim Jones
keyFigures.description: Kim Jones is the engineering mastermind behind BJR's success. His meticulous attention to detail and innovative problem-solving skills have been crucial in maximizing the performance of their cars.

headquarters: BJR operates from a modest workshop in Albury, New South Wales. The facilities are functional but basic, reflecting the team's pragmatic approach and focus on on-track performance.
fanBase: BJR enjoys a loyal following, particularly among fans who appreciate their underdog spirit and their commitment to supporting Australian drivers. They are seen as a team that represents the values of hard work, determination, and community spirit.
